solver_contract: Shared native solver is generated by the active longitudinal MPC with terminal speed, acceleration and distance constraints; stock runtime applies its unchanged constraint penalties at all N+1 stages

plannerd.py.adaptation: Planner/MPC imports redirected; independent existing conditional-mode owner and bounded transport connected outside unchanged upstream planner/MPC arithmetic. BOSCH-A HOOK: reads the BoschAStockBrakeFeel/BoschAHumanFollowing toggles once at start (bosch_a_toggles.read_toggles) and passes them to LongitudinalPlanner(bosch_a=...)

planner.py.adaptation: Only planner/MPC import paths redirected; no arithmetic/state/publisher changes when both Bosch-A toggles are off (bit-identical, test_bosch_a_toggles). BOSCH-A HOOK 1/3 (__init__): arms HumanFollowing/HumanAcceleration and the Stock Brake Feel enhancement only when the toggle is on and the car is a verified Bosch-A Honda with openpilot longitudinal (lazy imports). HOOK 2/3 (before mpc.update): HumanAcceleration cap (relaxed and standard personality only, via human_acceleration.applies) and model lead paths passed to the MPC. HOOK 3/3 (after output_should_stop, before the final clip): min with the HumanAcceleration cap, then honda_bosch_a_long step() BOSCH-A SMOOTH: bosch_a_smooth.BoschASmooth (Bosch-A Hondas only, always on) shortens action_t to min(0.30, delay+DT_MDL) and applies a brake release limit + 2-tick dwell to output_a_target before the final clip. BOSCH-A STOP GAP: bosch_a_stop_gap.BoschAStopGap (Bosch-A Hondas with the radar, always on) then holds shouldStop behind a stopped radar lead and caps the target at -0.25 while crawling inside the 6 m stop gap; it only adds braking. BOSCH-A ONSET RAMP: bosch_a_onset_ramp.BoschAOnsetRamp (Bosch-A Hondas, always on) runs after BOSCH-A SMOOTH and before BOSCH-A STOP GAP and limits how fast a far-lead (>= 40 m) brake deepens (8 m/s^3); it is off below 2 s to impact, on FCW and for a stop. ACCEL BOOST HOOK: accel_boost.AccelBoost, the same class the StarPilot planner uses (commaai/openpilot#39015), runs on output_a_target_e2e just before the candidates list; Experimental Mode only, it adds up to +0.2 m/s^2 to the e2e target after a gas press while the model is the slowest source, and the total is published as longitudinalPlan.accelBoost. This branch's planner has no Set Speed Assist

mpc.py.adaptation: Stock tuning and planner arithmetic unchanged; apply stock slack penalties at terminal stage for the shared constrained native solver. BOSCH-A HOOKs (keyword-only update args, default None = stock): lead_paths replaces a lead's raw extrapolation; acceleration_max replaces ACCEL_MAX only if finite and within [0, ACCEL_MAX]
